gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 3917.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Thoroughfare commencing at its junction with Taikoo Shing Road, running northward for a distance of approximately 113 metres to its junction with Taikoo Wan Road as shown coloured pink on Drawing No. HH 3065. Proposed Name: TAI FUNG AVENUE. Chinese Version: 太豐路.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此道路以其與太古城道交界處為起點，向北伸展約一一三米，至與太古灣道交界處終結，位置在 HH3065 號圖則上以粉紅色標明。
